instruction: Candid full-body documentary photograph of a subway station interior with metal turnstiles in the background. On the left, the blonde woman in a striped crop top and jeans (R1) walks forward with a bright smile, her right arm raised high. On the right, the bearded man in a blue long-sleeve shirt and khaki shorts (R2) walks beside her, looking at her warmly. They hold hands high above her head in a playful, spinning dance pose. The scene is illuminated by warm overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the tiled floor.
